units.source_text: 外间盛传红梅大纳言家里用心抚养着三位女公子，便有许多人陆续前来求婚。

en.t: Rumor spread widely that the Grand Counselor Kobai was carefully raising three young ladies in his household, and many suitors began coming one after another to ask for their hands.

units.source_text: 皇上和皇太子也曾表示有意。

en.t: The Emperor and the Crown Prince had also shown interest.

units.source_text: 红梅想道：“今上有明石皇后专宠，何等身份的人才能和她并肩呢？

en.t: Kobai thought, "The reigning Emperor is devoted above all to Empress Akashi; what sort of rank would a woman need in order to stand beside her?

units.source_text: 但倘为此而不图高位，情愿当个低级宫人，则又毫无意味。

en.t: But if, for that reason, one did not aim for a high position and was content to become a low-ranking court attendant, that would be meaningless too.

units.source_text: 皇太子为夕雾右大臣家的女御所独占，和她争宠，也很困难。

en.t: The Crown Prince, meanwhile, is monopolized by the consort from Minister of the Right Yugiri's family, and competing with her for his favor would also be difficult.

units.source_text: 然而只管如此畏首畏尾，家里有了才貌超群的女儿而不送她入宫，岂不辜负了她的美质呢？”

en.t: Yet if I keep shrinking back like this, and have a daughter of outstanding talent and beauty at home but do not send her to court, would that not waste her fine gifts?"

units.source_text: 他就下个决心，将大女公子配给了皇太子。

en.t: So he made up his mind and gave his eldest daughter to the Crown Prince.

units.source_text: 此时大女公子芳龄十七八岁，容姿绰约，非常可爱。

en.t: At that time, the eldest young lady was seventeen or eighteen, graceful in appearance and exceptionally lovely.
